subtitle: Baby Monitor & Pet Camera QR
promotional_text: Turn an old iPhone into a baby monitor or pet camera in seconds via QR code. Watch every room live in real time. Video stays on your devices, never on our servers.
description:
MioCam turns your iPhone or iPad into the simplest care window—for babies, pets, and every room at home.

■ QR code, connected
Scan the QR code on your camera device. Pair in seconds with no complicated setup.

■ Instantly start streaming
Reuse an old iPhone or iPad as a camera. Show the QR code from settings and start streaming right away.

■ Role: camera or monitor
Choose Camera to stream from this device, or Monitor to watch from another.

■ Every room, connected
Manage nursery, living room, and more from one monitor. See which cameras are online at a glance.

■ Watch live from anywhere
Real-time video over encrypted P2P WebRTC. We do not record or store your live feed on our servers.

■ Listen only when you need to
Turn the camera's audio on or off anytime. Watch video only by default, and check the sound when something matters.

Sign in with Apple to get started. Camera and Monitor require two separate devices.

Make your device the world's simplest care window with MioCam.
whats_new:
• Support for 5 languages (Japanese, English, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean)
• Improved App Store listings for international users
• UI improvements and stability enhancements
